name: c1-readout-query-covariance-regularization
purpose: Test whether a covariance penalty during the supervised C1 readout can retain the preregistered VICReg gain against B0 while avoiding unstable geometric concentration.

single_factor.name: supervised_query_covariance_penalty
single_factor.control: exact replay of v9 C1: fold-local VICReg S14 initialization followed by the historical supervised episodic readout
single_factor.candidate: the identical C1 replay with one additive covariance penalty during supervised readout
single_factor.penalty_tensor: the exact 100 post-L2 query embeddings per episode shared with the prototypical classification loss
single_factor.penalty_formula: L2-normalize query_raw once; center that shared query_normalized tensor by its batch mean; compute sample covariance with divisor n-1; square and sum all off-diagonal covariance entries; divide by embedding dimension 128
single_factor.coefficient_derivation: fixed a priori as the 1/25 VICReg covariance-to-invariance weight ratio
unchanged: official frozen DINOv2-S/14 features and five pinned v9 caches
fold-local VICReg objective, augmentation plan, coefficients, epochs, optimizer and seeds
ProjectionHead(384,384,128) architecture, C1 initialization and dropout
30 supervised epochs and 100 episodes per epoch
AdamW, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0001, temperature 0.1, warmup/cosine schedule and gradient clipping
folds 1-5, seeds 17,42,73, OOF rows, prototypes and 2000-replicate component bootstrap
no final-test access, runtime write, promotion or post-result coefficient adjustment

descriptive_engagement_outputs.mean_weighted_covariance_penalty_over_cl: persisted to distinguish a weakly scaled intervention from a refuted geometric hypothesis; it is not a post-result tuning trigger

rank_policy.rationale: iteration 6 found the old 0.9 proxy non-informative across five folds; it cannot be applied retroactively to C1

evaluation.measurement_limitation: Only 25 provenance components and 11 classes are independently evaluable OOF; a pass creates a research reference only.

decision_rule.supported: all integrity, efficacy, noninferiority and direct stability gates pass
decision_rule.intervention_not_engaged: integrity passes but the persisted mean covariance penalty is zero or non-finite
decision_rule.neutral_or_not_supported: integrity and engagement pass but any performance/stability gate fails
decision_rule.after_result: mandatory Council review before any next factor or closure
